title_candidates: Gemini 3.8 Live arrives: try a conversation you can interrupt
summary: Google's new voice models start rolling out to Gemini Live and Search Live. Try a ten-minute speaking rehearsal, without confusing a rollout announcement with access on your account.

primary_source.title: Introducing Gemini 3.8 Live and 3.8 Live Extended Thinking
primary_source.author: Google
key_facts: Google announced two voice models on September 15; standard Live emphasizes efficient conversation, Extended Thinking more complex tasks.
Extended Thinking rollout includes Gemini Live; standard Live includes Search Live. These are rollouts, not guaranteed universal access.
Google describes reasoning alongside speech and handling background tasks.

supporting_sources.title: Talk naturally with Gemini Live
key_facts: Android Live starts with Live button; signed-in eligible account and app required.
Users can interrupt, end and review transcript; updates arrive gradually.

prerequisites: An Android phone or tablet with the Gemini app and an up-to-date Google app
An eligible signed-in Google account with Gemini Live available
Microphone access and a quiet place; use fictional details

steps.instruction: Open the Gemini app on Android, tap **Live** at the bottom, and follow the microphone prompts. Check [Google's access requirements](https://support.google.com/gemini/answer/15274899?co=GENIE.Platform%3DAndroid&hl=en) if Live is missing; do not buy a subscription just to follow this test.
Say: "Help me rehearse a short introduction for a community event. Ask one question at a time, then give one specific improvement." Use an invented name and event.

Answer the first question. While Gemini replies, interrupt with: "Make it less formal, and keep the introduction under thirty seconds." Check whether it follows the changed request instead of finishing the old answer.
Rehearse once more. Judge the result against three checks: it asked one question at a time, accepted your correction, and gave advice you could actually use.
Tap **End** and inspect the transcript. Note any missed words or invented details. This tests the Live experience available to you, not which model your account is running.
